title: Version history
summary: Lists what changed in the app by day and then by build, newest first, from the same changelog as bipe.chat/versoes/. Opens from Configurações › Ajuda › Histórico de versões.

kind.description: What sort of change it is.

detail.description: More text in English. Can be empty.

version.description: The version name of the build, for example 1.0.1.

builds.description: Newest first, grouped by date. Only builds with a change for this platform.

loading.description: True while the app gets the list.

failed.description: True when the list did not load.

load.effect: Gets the changelog JSON from the versionsData url of registries/settings.json (in the app language) when the screen opens.

retry.effect: Gets the list again after a failure.

notes: The data is bipe-app tools/changelog.mjs --json. bipe-web publishes it next to the page (versoes/changelog.json, en/versions/changelog.json) on every deploy, so the screen also shows builds newer than the installed one.

MZ, 4 Nov 2026: a section is one day (the date as its heading), and inside it each build has a label: bipe_help_version with "1.0.1 (446)", the same text as the Ajuda e sobre row of settings-root, or bipe_versions_build when the build has no version. Each change shows its headline, its detail and the kind label. The screen does not show whether a version is released or in testing.
The headline and detail are in English and are not translated; bipe_versions_note says so in pt.
No account and no token: the file is public.
